tasks.gr9-poetry-drama-study-t2: Topic: Poetry and drama study. Cover literary devices (rhyme, imagery, tone, theme, symbolism), characterisation, dialogue, scene analysis, and close text interpretation. Ask Grade 9 learners to analyse poetic and dramatic devices, identify literary effects, support responses with textual evidence, use line references to justify interpretations, and connect theme to character and conflict.
tasks.gr9-letters-reviews-t2: Topic: Letters and reviews. Cover friendly and formal letters, email, review writing, register (formal vs informal), layout conventions, and review criteria. Ask Grade 9 learners to adapt tone and format for personal and formal communication, match register to relationship and context, structure reviews with evaluation criteria, and demonstrate mastery of letter layout conventions.
tasks.gr9-sentence-structure-cohesion-t2: Topic: Sentence structure and cohesion. Cover pronouns, prepositions, conjunctions, simple, compound and complex sentences, tense consistency. Ask Grade 9 learners to improve cohesion through sentence combining, identify pronoun reference issues, use conjunctions to clarify relationships, maintain tense consistency in extended responses, and apply sentence variety for stylistic effect.
